arguments.name: name
arguments.description: (Required) Name of the scaling plan. Names cannot contain vertical bars, colons, or forward slashes.

arguments.name: cloudformationStackArn
arguments.description: (Optional) ARN of a AWS CloudFormation stack.

arguments.name: key
arguments.description: (Required) Tag key.

arguments.name: values
arguments.description: (Optional) Tag values.

arguments.name: disableDynamicScaling
arguments.description: (Optional) Boolean controlling whether dynamic scaling by AWS Auto Scaling is disabled. Defaults to `false`.

arguments.name: maxCapacity
arguments.description: (Required) Maximum capacity of the resource. The exception to this upper limit is if you specify a non-default setting for `predictiveScalingMaxCapacityBehavior`.

arguments.name: minCapacity
arguments.description: (Required) Minimum capacity of the resource.

arguments.name: predictiveScalingMaxCapacityBehavior
arguments.description: (Optional) Defines the behavior that should be applied if the forecast capacity approaches or exceeds the maximum capacity specified for the resource.

arguments.name: predictiveScalingMaxCapacityBuffer
arguments.description: (Optional) Size of the capacity buffer to use when the forecast capacity is close to or exceeds the maximum capacity.

arguments.name: predictiveScalingMode
arguments.description: (Optional) Predictive scaling mode. Valid values: `ForecastAndScale`, `ForecastOnly`.

arguments.name: resourceId
arguments.description: (Required) ID of the resource. This string consists of the resource type and unique identifier.

arguments.name: scalableDimension
arguments.description: (Required) Scalable dimension associated with the resource. Valid values: `autoscaling:autoScalingGroup:DesiredCapacity`, `dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits`, `dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits`, `dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits`, `dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits`, `ecs:service:DesiredCount`, `ec2:spot-fleet-request:TargetCapacity`, `rds:cluster:ReadReplicaCount`.

arguments.name: scalingPolicyUpdateBehavior
arguments.description: (Optional) Controls whether a resource's externally created scaling policies are kept or replaced. Valid values: `KeepExternalPolicies`, `ReplaceExternalPolicies`. Defaults to `KeepExternalPolicies`.

arguments.name: scheduledActionBufferTime
arguments.description: (Optional) Amount of time, in seconds, to buffer the run time of scheduled scaling actions when scaling out.

arguments.name: serviceNamespace
arguments.description: (Required) Namespace of the AWS service. Valid values: `autoscaling`, `dynamodb`, `ecs`, `ec2`, `rds`.

arguments.name: dimensions
arguments.description: (Optional) Dimensions of the metric.

arguments.name: metricName
arguments.description: (Required) Name of the metric.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: (Required) Namespace of the metric.

arguments.name: statistic
arguments.description: (Required) Statistic of the metric. Currently, the value must always be `Sum`.

arguments.name: unit
arguments.description: (Optional) Unit of the metric.

arguments.name: predefinedLoadMetricType
arguments.description: (Required) Metric type. Valid values: `ALBTargetGroupRequestCount`, `ASGTotalCPUUtilization`, `ASGTotalNetworkIn`, `ASGTotalNetworkOut`.

arguments.name: resourceLabel
arguments.description: (Optional) Identifies the resource associated with the metric type.

arguments.name: disableScaleIn
arguments.description: (Optional) Boolean indicating whether scale in by the target tracking scaling policy is disabled. Defaults to `false`.

arguments.name: estimatedInstanceWarmup
arguments.description: (Optional) Estimated time, in seconds, until a newly launched instance can contribute to the CloudWatch metrics.

arguments.name: scaleInCooldown
arguments.description: (Optional) Amount of time, in seconds, after a scale in activity completes before another scale in activity can start.

arguments.name: scaleOutCooldown
arguments.description: (Optional) Amount of time, in seconds, after a scale-out activity completes before another scale-out activity can start.

arguments.name: targetValue
arguments.description: (Required) Target value for the metric.

arguments.name: dimensions
arguments.description: (Optional) Dimensions of the metric.

arguments.name: metricName
arguments.description: (Required) Name of the metric.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: (Required) Namespace of the metric.

arguments.name: statistic
arguments.description: (Required) Statistic of the metric. Valid values: `Average`, `Maximum`, `Minimum`, `SampleCount`, `Sum`.

arguments.name: unit
arguments.description: (Optional) Unit of the metric.

arguments.name: predefinedScalingMetricType
arguments.description: (Required) Metric type. Valid values: `ALBRequestCountPerTarget`, `ASGAverageCPUUtilization`, `ASGAverageNetworkIn`, `ASGAverageNetworkOut`, `DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization`, `DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization`, `ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization`, `ECSServiceAverageMemoryUtilization`, `EC2SpotFleetRequestAverageCPUUtilization`, `EC2SpotFleetRequestAverageNetworkIn`, `EC2SpotFleetRequestAverageNetworkOut`, `RDSReaderAverageCPUUtilization`, `RDSReaderAverageDatabaseConnections`.

arguments.name: resourceLabel
arguments.description: (Optional) Identifies the resource associated with the metric type.
